India aims for $1 trillion exports by FY27

Union Minister Piyush Goyal has expressed confidence that India will achieve its target of $1 trillion in exports by the fiscal year 2027. The strategy to reach this goal reportedly involves leveraging Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), industry sectors, Global Capability Centers (GCCs), and startups.
